caption:
@slashfi CEO Victor cardenas says If you want to make serious money with AI, don’t start by building something new. Start by looking at businesses that are still running on outdated systems like fax machines, manual processes, and old workflows.

 These businesses already exist, they already make money, and they already have problems. Your job is simple: go in, automate their process with AI, and offer them a better, faster system. That’s where the opportunity is.

Instead of trying to build a complex startup from day one, you can start with AI consulting for an underserved industry. Work closely with them, understand their problems, and solve them using AI. Once you see patterns and repeated use cases, you can turn that into a software product that doesn’t depend on your time.

You don’t need a brand new idea. You need a proven market and a better solution.
